scope: Read-only recommendation for the next bounded paper-discovery package. No product implementation, Git mutation, live connector call, credential access, or fixture promotion was performed.

w1_boundary.finding: W1 connector-request.v1 and connector-observation.v1 cannot be reused unchanged for general discovery.
reasons: W1 request fixes adapter=arxiv-abs-normalized-v1, one official arxiv.org/abs page, one paper identity and the page-rendering parser profile.
W1 observation payload is a normalized arXiv abstract page with named sections and version markers; OpenAlex list/search/citation responses have different result, cursor and relation semantics.
W1 budgets and arXiv three-second request policy are not a general provider contract.
W1 transport fields describe one page observation and do not model provider query cost, cursor continuation, indexed-reference completeness or provider authentication mode.
reuse: Reuse the W1 JCS/envelope discipline, exact reference hashes, bounded JSON parsing, no-symlink staging helpers and five-directory session root.
Reference W1 metadata and preview artifacts by typed exact refs; do not add discovery fields to any W1 closed schema.
Use paper request/preview/decide for a discovered candidate only after candidate identity has been resolved; discovery does not mint a preview or decision implicitly.

openalex_read_only_capability_observatio.api_key_policy: If a platform connector requires a key, it must remain platform-managed and outside request/observation bytes; the local Python package never reads, stores or emits credentials.
documented_work_operations: outgoing references through a work's referenced_works list
integrity_limits_to_record: OpenAlex states that reference matching can omit works absent from OpenAlex or references whose metadata match fails; a discovery observation is indexed-source evidence, never proof of a complete PDF bibliography.
OpenAlex relevance_score and citation counts are provider signals; preserve them as source-local fields and never add them directly to scores from another ranker.
Actual platform Web connector access, exposed headers, rate-limit headers, cursor stability and anonymous API reachability remain unverified until a separately held-out live observation is recorded.

namespace_and_storage.file_hash_reference: SHA256(complete UTF-8 JSON document plus exactly one LF)
invariants: No mutable head file, database, parallel research root or engine catalog write.
Every cross-object reference carries the typed rw3 ID and exact file SHA-256; the validator reads only the expected session directory and rechecks the complete graph on success and failure paths.
A same-content object is idempotently reused; a same ID with different bytes is a staged conflict and exits 75.
Unexpected files, symlinks, special files, traversal, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite numbers, over-depth JSON and over-limit strings are refusals.
Candidate and rank artifacts are disposable proposals; only explicit candidate-decision and later W2 handoff can advance a user-selected paper.

query_rules: Only canonical OpenAlex IDs, canonical arXiv IDs, bounded normalized search text or typed seed refs are accepted; title-only guessing is refused.
The generated host is api.openalex.org and the generated path/query is canonicalized from structured fields; caller-supplied arbitrary URLs are refused.
At most one search mode is present per request; search text is capped so the generated URL stays below the documented approximately 4094-byte limit.
per_page is 1..100; cursor is an opaque bounded continuation value and is carried forward only from a validated observation.
API keys, Authorization headers and platform account identifiers never occur in the request document.
discovery_request_profile.request_semantics: One bounded provider operation. No automatic retry, no direct Python socket/network, no PDF/fulltext/weight/data download, and no implicit cursor walk. A later request-next explicitly names the prior cursor and receives a new immutable request.

identity_rules: Each result requires at least one stable external ID: OpenAlex work ID, canonical arXiv ID or normalized DOI.
Resolution precedence is exact arXiv/DOI/OpenAlex identity, then explicit crosswalk evidence; title similarity alone never merges entities.
Conflicting stable IDs remain separate with identity_resolution=conflict and cannot silently collapse into one candidate.
OpenAlex citation/reference signals are source evidence with indexed-source completeness; they do not become W1 metadata or full-text proof.
discovery_observation_profile.transport_rules: Transport fields remain null plus unavailable_reason unless the platform connector actually exposes them. A normalized observation never claims raw response bytes, headers, API-key use, complete citation coverage or server-side rate-limit enforcement.

round_rules: Round request and observation refs are sorted by exact ref bytes before semantic hashing.
A failed provider observation is retained as evidence and cannot produce a successful candidate result; resume starts from the last complete immutable round.
Runtime duration, worker count and arrival order are scheduling evidence only and are excluded from normalized candidate/rank/stop semantics.
Parallelism 1 and N over the same frozen observation set and config must produce byte-identical normalized candidates, ranks and stop decision.

candidate_rules: Candidate has no action or user decision field.
Version merge is separate from entity deduplication; resolved entity IDs are stable and source version labels remain visible.
Every why_found item names a seed, relation, observation ref and structured reason terms; free-form LLM explanation cannot replace evidence.
Multiple URLs from one original source or mirror group do not count as independent evidence; unknown independence remains visible.
A candidate can be previewed through W1 only after paper request validates its exact canonical identity.
rank_rules: Source lists are ranked independently; provider relevance/citation values are never numerically added to another ranker's raw score.
Initial decomposition is seed distance, relation type, publication-year signal, provider citation signal, topic overlap and source diversity; each term is retained separately.
Deterministic RRF uses a frozen integer k and canonical entity ID lexical tie-break.
Identity-conflict candidates are not merged and are marked in the rank output.

default_thresholds.paths_covered: each required lens has a completed observation or explicit not_applicable reason and no required lens remains pending
default_thresholds.budget_exhausted: any frozen count or byte cap is reached

rules: All matched reasons are recorded; primary_reason is selected only by the frozen precedence list.
No wall-clock timeout can be the semantic stop reason; per-request deadlines remain connector outcome fields.
Resume validates the complete session, round, observation, candidate and rank graph before issuing the next request.
A user stop does not delete pending candidates or rewrite prior events.

proposed_cli: vpwiki-research research start --session SESSION --seed REF [--seed REF ...] --config CONFIG.json
vpwiki-research research observe --session SESSION --request REQUEST.json --observation OBSERVATION.json
vpwiki-research research stop --session SESSION --event-id ID --user-text TEXT
vpwiki-research paper request/preview/decide for each selected candidate
prohibited_paths_and_behaviors: No edits to W1 schema bytes, engine source, catalog/overlay seed count, vendor sources or real Vault.
No direct Python HTTP/socket client, API-key read, subprocess connector, PDF/fulltext/weight/data download or automatic ingest.
No title-only identity merge, raw-score fusion, hidden retry, implicit cursor walk, mutable failed terminal or user-decision synthesis.
No live OpenAlex response copied into checked-in fixtures; live capability evidence remains a separate held-out record.
acceptance_vectors: Frozen normalized OpenAlex-like observations with references, citations and related works produce exact candidate/rank/stop bytes under scheduler parallelism 1 and N.
Duplicate IDs across sources merge only with explicit stable identity evidence; conflicting DOI/arXiv/OpenAlex IDs remain visible and separate.
OpenAlex indexed-reference incompleteness is rendered as a limitation, never as complete bibliography coverage.
Cursor continuation, per_page=100 boundary, approximately 4094-byte query boundary, 429 observation and missing credential capability all fail or resume with stable closed errors.
A candidate preview and append-only decision create exact W1 references and no Vault/catalog/index changes.
Malformed, oversized, symlinked, stale, reordered, duplicated or cross-session artifacts refuse without overwriting prior bytes.
blockers: This design is not an implementation authorization or a replacement for an exact W3 packet/freeze.
A separate held-out platform connector observation is required before claiming OpenAlex access, transport fields, authentication mode or response shape.
